limitedContextLabel.message: Use limited context for selection translation

triggerIndependenceHelp.message: Page translation shortcuts are managed globally by the browser; inline selection translation is monitored by in-page scripts. Input fields and editable regions are excluded. The floating button and inline shortcuts operate independently. Using the same trigger again removes the current inline translation.

selectionPreferencesMigrationHint.message: Inline selection shortcuts and triggers have moved to the "Shortcuts & triggers" section.
